ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:0.speaker: Mireille
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:0.original: Good morning, twins! Come on, wake up! It's a lovely morning!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:0.translation: Доброе утро, близнецы! Давайте, просыпайтесь! Какое чудесное утро!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:1.original: Uwah. Mireille? What are you doing here so early?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:1.translation: Ува. Мирей? Что ты здесь делаешь так рано?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:2.original: Come on... Just two more hours...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:3.speaker: Mireille
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:3.original: No. Wake up! We're going to have some fun today!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:3.translation: Нет. Просыпайтесь! Сегодня мы будем веселиться!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:5.speaker: Mireille
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:5.original: Hahah! I'm calling this "Vacation 2: The Revenge"! Come on, hurry up! Vacation time!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:5.translation: Ха-ха! Я называю это «Каникулы 2: Месть»! Давайте, быстрее! Время каникул!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:6.original: Hey, hold on! Uwah, sounds like we don't have a choice... Sue, let's just go with her.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:6.translation: Эй, погоди! Ух, похоже, выбора нет... Сью, давай просто пойдём с ней.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:9.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:9.translation: Кьяа! Это было подло! Получай сдачи!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:10.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:10.original: Puwah! Hahaha, Lucia! Was that a declaration of war?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:10.translation: Пува! Ха-ха-ха, Люсия! Это было объявление войны?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:11.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:11.original: What? No, that was an accident! Just an accident!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:11.translation: Что? Нет, это случайность! Просто случайность!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:12.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:12.original: Too late for that! Take this, and this, and this!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:12.translation: Поздно! Получай, и ещё, и ещё!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:13.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:13.original: Uwah, hold on, you're too strong! Sophie, that's some crazy water pressure you've got going there!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:13.translation: Ува, погоди, ты слишком сильная! Софи, у тебя там какой-то безумный напор воды!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:14.original: Hahaha, more allies! Get her, Sophie! Fugwaaah!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:14.translation: Ха-ха-ха, ещё союзники! Достань её, Софи! Фугвааа!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:15.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:15.original: Naive. As naive as a kitten, little Sue! Drop your guard in battle and you're finished!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:15.translation: Наивно. Наивная, как котёнок, маленькая Сью! Потеряешь бдительность в бою — и конец!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:16.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:16.original: That's actually great advice. Maybe you should listen to it yourself?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:16.translation: На самом деле отличный совет. Может, тебе самой стоит ему последовать?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:17.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:17.original: Haha, now Sue! Take her down!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:18.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:18.original: Leave it to me! Lucia! Firis! Prepare yourselves!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:18.translation: Оставь это мне! Люсия! Фирис! Готовьтесь!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:19.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:19.original: I. Will. Not. Lose! Victory will be mine!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:19.translation: Я. Не. Проиграю! Победа будет моей!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:20.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:20.original: Never! As your teacher, it's time to school you again!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:20.translation: Никогда! Как ваша учительница, пора снова вас проучить!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:21.speaker: Mireille
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:21.original: Ah! A little vacation, a stiff drink! This is the life! *hic*
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:21.translation: Ах! Небольшой отдых, крепкий напиток! Вот это жизнь! *ик*

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:22.speaker: Mireille
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:22.original: That other vacation wasn't a vacation at all, so I invited them all back again.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:22.translation: Те прошлые каникулы вообще не были каникулами, поэтому я снова всех пригласила.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:23.speaker: Mireille
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:23.original: Looks like they're enjoying themselves, too! Aah, that's so good!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:23.translation: Похоже, им тоже весело! Ааа, как хорошо!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:24.speaker: Mireille
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:24.original: This wine is delicious! Vacations are the best! Hahaha!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_010.ebm:24.translation: Это вино восхитительно! Каникулы — лучшее! Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:0.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:0.original: That's the way it is, Corneria baby!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:0.translation: Вот так оно и есть, Корнерия, детка!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:1.original: Uwah, that surprised me. Was that Sophie's voice?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:1.translation: Ува, вот это сюрприз. Это был голос Софи?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:3.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:3.original: You know, I mean, Firis is really such a great person...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:3.translation: Знаешь, я имею в виду... Фирис такая замечательная...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:4.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:4.original: She even comes to my defense when Plachta gets angry with me! I really love her, you know?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:4.translation: Она даже встаёт на мою защиту, когда Плахта на меня злится! Я её очень люблю, понимаешь?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:5.speaker: Corneria
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:5.original: I see, I see. Ah, excuse me. One beer please.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:5.translation: Понятно, понятно. Ах, извините. Одно пиво, пожалуйста.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:6.speaker: Master
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:6.original: I told you once, already. You're still a child. No alcohol for you.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:6.translation: Я уже говорил тебе. Ты ещё ребёнок. Алкоголя тебе не положено.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:7.speaker: Master
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:7.original: Here's some M I L K for you.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:7.translation: Вот тебе М О Л О К О.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:8.speaker: Corneria
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:8.original: I've been an adult for quite a while though...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:9.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:9.original: Plachta is really kind, though, too. She massaged my shoulders the other day!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:9.translation: Хотя Плахта тоже очень добрая. На днях она массировала мне плечи!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:10.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:10.original: "Are you OK, Sophie? You need to release some of this tension." Hah, how's my Plachta sound?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:10.translation: «С тобой всё в порядке, Софи? Тебе нужно снять это напряжение». Ха, как звучит моя Плахта?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:11.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:11.original: She's thinking about me, of course. It makes me want to prepare some stew for her, you know?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:11.translation: Она думает обо мне, конечно. Мне хочется приготовить для неё тушёное мясо, понимаешь?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:12.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:12.original: Hey, hold on? Are you listening to me, Corny?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:12.translation: Эй, погоди? Ты меня слушаешь, Корни?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:13.speaker: Corneria
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:13.original: Yes, I'm listening. I'm glad to see you and Plachta are still good friends.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:13.translation: Да, слушаю. Рада видеть, что вы с Плахтой до сих пор хорошие подруги.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:15.speaker: Corneria
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:15.original: Hahaha. I'm glad to hear it.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:16.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:16.original: Ah! It's nice to see you smile again, Corny! Corneria baby!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:16.translation: Ах! Приятно снова видеть твою улыбку, Корни! Корнерия, детка!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:17.speaker: Corneria
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:17.original: Uwah! S-Sophie, don't just grab me like that!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:17.translation: Ува! С-Софи, не хватай меня так!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:18.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:18.original: Why not? We're friends, right? Hehe!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:18.translation: Почему нет? Мы же подруги, да? Хе-хе!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:19.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:19.original: Uwah, I had no idea! Sophie looks hard to handle when she's drunk!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:19.translation: Ува, я и не подозревала! С Софи, когда она пьяна, похоже, трудно справиться!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:20.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:20.original: Hahaha. That was a bit unexpected, wasn't it?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:20.translation: Ха-ха-ха. Это было немного неожиданно, правда?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:21.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:21.original: Sue. We'd better not tell anyone about this.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:21.translation: Сью. Лучше никому об этом не рассказывать.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:22.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:22.original: Yes, you're right. That's probably better for everyone.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_020.ebm:22.translation: Да, ты права. Наверное, так будет лучше для всех.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:1.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:1.original: Ilmeria! I didn't expect to bump into you here. Maybe this is fate?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:1.translation: Ильмерия! Не ожидала встретить тебя здесь. Может, это судьба?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:2.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:2.original: Huh? What are you rambling on about now?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:2.translation: А? О чём ты сейчас болтаешь?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:3.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:3.original: It was your birthday recently, right? So now you're an adult?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:3.translation: Недавно у тебя был день рождения, верно? Значит, теперь ты взрослая?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:4.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:4.original: Yes, that's right. You too, if I recall correctly?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:4.translation: Да, верно. И ты тоже, если я правильно помню?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:5.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:5.original: Yes, that's right. So then, Ilmeria... How about we both become adults together?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:5.translation: Да, верно. Так вот, Ильмерия... Как насчёт того, чтобы мы обе стали взрослыми вместе?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:7.original: Heheh! I've been looking forward to being able to drink for a long time!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:7.translation: Хе-хе! Я уже давно жду, когда смогу выпить!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:8.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:8.original: Seriously. You could have started with that! You gave me all sorts of strange ideas!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:8.translation: Серьёзно. Можно было начать с этого! Ты навеяла мне всякие странные мысли!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:10.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:10.original: Like nothing! A drink, please! The strongest you've got!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:10.translation: Никакие! Напиток, пожалуйста! Самый крепкий, что есть!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:11.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:11.original: Hitting the ground running, Il! I like it! The same for me!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:11.translation: Сразу в бой, Ил! Мне нравится! Мне то же самое!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:12.speaker: Master
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:12.original: Here are your drinks. This is spirytus.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:13.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:13.original: Spirytus? Uwah, it even smells potent!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:14.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:14.original: Oh dear, getting scared already? You're still a little girl, Firis!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:14.translation: О боже, уже струсила? Ты всё ещё маленькая девочка, Фирис!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:15.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:15.original: Gah! No I'm not! Down the hatch!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:16.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:16.original: You can't get the jump on me! Here goes!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:18.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:18.original: Hahaha, Ilmeria! Weak! Too weak! Hahaha!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:18.translation: Ха-ха-ха, Ильмерия! Слабо! Слишком слабо! Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:19.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:19.original: What should we do? It feels like we've witnessed something pretty crazy again...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:19.translation: Что нам делать? Такое ощущение, что мы снова стали свидетельницами чего-то совсем безумного...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:20.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:20.original: Hahaha, you said it. Firis looks like she'll be a hard drinker.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:20.translation: Ха-ха-ха, точно. Фирис выглядит так, будто из неё выйдет крепкий пьяница.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:22.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:22.original: Whatever are you doing here? Hahaha! Come on, get over here and join us!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:22.translation: Что вы здесь делаете? Ха-ха-ха! Давайте, идите сюда и присоединяйтесь!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:24.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:24.original: P-Pretend we didn't hear her, Sue! Just a case of mistaken identity! Keep moving!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:24.translation: П-притворись, что мы её не слышали, Сью! Просто ошибка! Идём дальше!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:25.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:25.original: Hey! Can't you hear me? Hahaha! I guess it can't be helped, Ilmeria!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:25.translation: Эй! Вы меня не слышите? Ха-ха-ха! Ничего не поделаешь, Ильмерия!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:26.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:26.original: Zzzzz... Firis, you hear me? Don't leave my side...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:26.translation: Ззззз... Фирис, слышишь? Не оставляй меня...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:27.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:27.original: Hahaha! Ilmeria is talking in her sleep! Poke, poke! Hahaha!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:27.translation: Ха-ха-ха! Ильмерия разговаривает во сне! Тык-тык! Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:29.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:29.original: Hey, Lydie. One thing. When we grow up...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:29.translation: Эй, Лиди. Одно дело. Когда мы вырастем...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:30.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:30.original: I was thinking the same thing. No drinking.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:30.translation: Я думала о том же. Никакого питья.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:31.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:31.original: Hahaha! Keep the drinks coming! Hahaha!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:32.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:32.original: Dummy. Firis you dummy. But that's just another thing about you... that I...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_030.ebm:32.translation: Дура. Фирис, ты дура. Но это ещё одна твоя черта... которую я...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:0.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:0.original: Enough games. Spill it! Why have you turned back to Luard?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:0.translation: Хватит игр. Выкладывай! Почему ты снова стал Луардом?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:1.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:1.original: Yeah, spill it! You said you could never turn back, right? So I was told!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:1.translation: Да, выкладывай! Ты же говорил, что никогда не вернёшься, верно? Мне так сказали!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:2.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:2.original: If you're planning something nasty again, you know what will happen, right?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:2.translation: Если снова задумал что-то гадкое — ты ведь знаешь, что будет, да?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:3.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:3.original: You've got me all wrong, honestly! I didn't really want to turn back!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:3.translation: Вы меня неправильно поняли, честное слово! Я совсем не хотел снова становиться собой!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:4.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:4.original: I was doing some pretty serious synthesizing and I fell into my cauldron, alright?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:4.translation: Я занимался довольно серьёзным синтезом и упал в свой котёл, ясно?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:5.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:5.original: Perhaps it was a miracle, I don't know, but I got turned back to my original body. And was de-aged...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:5.translation: Может, это чудо, не знаю, но я вернулся в своё настоящее тело. И помолодел...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:6.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:6.original: Hmm. So long as that's all this is, fine...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:6.translation: Хм. Если на этом всё — ладно...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:7.original: Thank goodness for that, Alt. I thought Miss Sophie was going to have to beat you down again!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:7.translation: Слава богу, Альт. Я думала, мисс Софи снова придётся тебя отколошматить!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:8.original: "Again"? Sophie, you've beaten Alt up - sorry, down - in the past?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:8.translation: «Снова»? Софи, ты в прошлом била Альта... то есть колотила?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:9.original: Uwah, that's unexpected! You don't have the face for such violence, Sophie!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:9.translation: Ух, неожиданно! У тебя совсем не такое лицо для такого насилия, Софи!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:10.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:10.original: Girls! No, you've got this all wrong. Well, not all wrong, but there was a reason...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:10.translation: Девочки! Нет, вы всё неправильно поняли. Ну, не совсем неправильно, но была причина...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:11.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:11.original: Man, it was really scary... Sophie and all her pretty little goons, beating on poor little me...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:11.translation: Блин, было реально страшно... Софи и все её милые головорезы избивали бедного маленького меня...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:12.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:12.original: And all I was doing was some research in my atelier! Ah, I can hardly bare to think about it...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:12.translation: А я всего лишь занимался исследованиями в своём ателье! Эх, даже думать об этом тяжело...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:14.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:14.original: Is that really what happened? Hearing Alt's side of it, I'm starting to sympathize with him.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:14.translation: Правда так было? Слушая версию Альта, я начинаю ему сочувствовать.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:15.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:15.original: Not you too, Firis! I think you're all getting the wrong idea here!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:15.translation: И ты туда же, Фирис! Мне кажется, вы все неправильно поняли!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:16.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:16.original: Hehehe. Looks like the tables have turned!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:18.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:18.original: Hey! Now you're attacking me with your staff?! Be more aware of your own strength!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:18.translation: Эй! Теперь ты бьёшь меня посохом?! Лучше осознавай свою силу!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:19.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:19.original: Hahaha! Can I get in on this action?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:20.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:20.original: Firis! Not you, too! This isn't fair!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:20.translation: Фирис! И ты тоже! Это нечестно!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:21.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:21.original: I've no idea what happened, but the three of them seem like pretty good friends...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:21.translation: Понятия не имею, что произошло, но эти трое кажутся довольно хорошими друзьями...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:23.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:23.original: Girls, please! Stop smiling on the sidelines and help me! Save me!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_040.ebm:23.translation: Девочки, пожалуйста! Перестаньте улыбаться в сторонке и помогите мне! Спасите!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:1.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:1.original: Hello, Plachta. What's wrong? Are you lost?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:1.translation: Привет, Плахта. Что случилось? Ты заблудилась?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:2.speaker: Plachta
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:2.original: Me? Of course not. I just came to chat with you a little about the past.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:2.translation: Я? Конечно нет. Я просто зашла немного поговорить с тобой о прошлом.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:3.speaker: Plachta
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:3.original: About the "Alt" who inspired your fake name.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:3.translation: Об «Альте», который вдохновил тебя на вымышленное имя.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:4.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:4.original: Ah. He was a great guy, wasn't he? Smart, cheerful, and a skilled alchemist.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:4.translation: Ах. Он был отличным парнем, правда? Умный, весёлый и искусный алхимик.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:5.speaker: Plachta
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:5.original: Indeed. Friendly, too, and he loved to travel. He told me many stories of the places he had been.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:5.translation: Да. И дружелюбный, и любил путешествовать. Он рассказывал мне много историй о местах, где бывал.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:6.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:6.original: Which reminds me, Meklet and Atomina, my former bodies... were also based on him, weren't they?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:6.translation: Кстати, Меклет и Атомина, мои прежние тела... тоже были основаны на нём, верно?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:7.speaker: Plachta
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:7.original: Indeed. An attempt to surprise him, wasn't it? And I think he was pretty surprised.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:7.translation: Да. Попытка его удивить, не так ли? И, думаю, он здорово удивился.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:8.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:8.original: Haha! If two people looking just like me showed up, I'd be surprised too!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:8.translation: Ха-ха! Если бы появились двое, похожих на меня, я бы тоже удивился!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:9.speaker: Plachta
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:9.original: That's true for anyone, I believe. So tell me, Luard...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:9.translation: Это верно для любого, полагаю. Так скажи мне, Луард...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:11.speaker: Plachta
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:11.original: You've been searching for him, haven't you? Have you learned anything?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:11.translation: Ты искал его, не так ли? Узнал ли что-нибудь?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:12.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:12.original: No, not really. I know he went to an island floating in the sky, and nothing from there...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:12.translation: Нет, не особо. Знаю, что он отправился на парящий в небе остров, а дальше — ничего...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:13.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:13.original: But you know him. Wherever he died, he was surely happy.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:13.translation: Но ты его знаешь. Где бы он ни умер — наверняка был счастлив.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:14.speaker: Plachta
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:14.original: Yes, you're right. I'd like to believe that too.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:14.translation: Да, ты прав. Мне тоже хотелось бы в это верить.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:15.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:15.original: Once you die yourself, you can ask him. I'm sure he'll happily share his adventures with you.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:15.translation: Когда сама умрёшь — спросишь его. Уверен, он с радостью поделится с тобой приключениями.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:16.speaker: Plachta
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:16.original: Hehe, indeed. I bet he's made a secret fort in heaven already.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:16.translation: Хе-хе, верно. Бьюсь об заклад, он уже построил секретный форт на небесах.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:17.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:17.original: More than possible! Until that time comes, though, let's live our lives to the fullest. For him, too.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:17.translation: Более чем возможно! Но пока это время не пришло — давай жить полной жизнью. И ради него тоже.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:18.speaker: Plachta
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:18.original: I agree with the sentiment. To create the world of peace that he himself dreamed of.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_050.ebm:18.translation: Согласна с этим. Создать мир мира, о котором он сам мечтал.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:2.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:2.original: Hehe, I just bumped into someone really funny! I've got to tell you about it!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:2.translation: Хе-хе, я только что столкнулась с кем-то совсем забавным! Обязательно расскажу!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:3.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:3.original: This guy, right, he had a Puni in a basket! When I ask him why...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:3.translation: Этот парень, да, у него в корзине был Пуни! Когда я спрашиваю, зачем...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:8.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:8.original: Hehe, surprised you! Another successful prank.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:8.translation: Хе-хе, удивила тебя! Ещё один удачный розыгрыш.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:9.original: A-Are you alright, Firis? That was quite a scream.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:9.translation: Т-ты в порядке, Фирис? Вот это был крик.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:10.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:10.original: I'm okay... I mean, I'm not, but I am. That just brought back some old memories...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:10.translation: Я в порядке... То есть нет, но да. Это просто вернуло старые воспоминания...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:12.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:12.original: Hehe. Firis and I have been friends for a long time.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:12.translation: Хе-хе. Мы с Фирис дружим уже давно.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:13.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:13.original: This isn't the first time Pamela has surprised me. She almost gave me a heart attack before.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:13.translation: Это не первый раз, когда Памела меня пугает. Раньше она чуть не довела меня до сердечного приступа.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:14.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:14.original: So you've come to Merveille too, Pamela? Are you going to be opening a shop again?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:14.translation: Так ты тоже приехала в Мервейль, Памела? Собираешься снова открыть магазин?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:15.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:15.original: Yes, that's right! I'm going to be a nun at the church as well.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:15.translation: Да, верно! А ещё я буду монахиней в церкви.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:16.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:16.original: A nun? You really are a nun, Pamela?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:17.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:17.original: You really can't tell? Well, no matter.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:18.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:18.original: I've got a great line up, just like before. Come and shop any time, Firis.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:18.translation: У меня отличный ассортимент, как и раньше. Заходи за покупками в любое время, Фирис.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:19.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:19.original: I will! I'm looking forward to it!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:21.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:21.original: Haha! She hasn't changed at all.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:22.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:22.original: I'm glad you met your friend... hey, hold on! What about the Puni in the basket?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:22.translation: Рада, что ты встретила подругу... эй, погоди! А как же Пуни в корзине?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:23.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:23.original: What? Oh, that. I've completely forgotten.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:23.translation: Что? А, это. Я совсем забыла.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:24.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:24.original: Aw, no way! Talk about being left in suspense!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_060.ebm:24.translation: Эх, ну вот! Оставила нас в полном неведении!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:0.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:0.original: Hey, a church! This reminds me of the one back home...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:0.translation: Эй, церковь! Напоминает ту, что у нас дома...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:1.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:1.original: This peaceful quiet. A large statue of the goddess. And... hold on! Pamela?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:1.translation: Эта мирная тишина. Большая статуя богини. И... погоди! Памела?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:2.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:2.original: Oh my, if it isn't Sophie! Nice to see you! Look how big you are now!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:2.translation: О боже, да это же Софи! Рада тебя видеть! Смотри, какая ты теперь большая!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:3.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:3.original: Pamela! What are you doing here? I thought you went back to Kirchen Bell?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:3.translation: Памела! Что ты здесь делаешь? Я думала, ты вернулась в Кирхенбелл?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:4.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:4.original: That was the plan. I wanted to catch a cart to Reisenberg, but I took the wrong one.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:4.translation: Таков был план. Хотела сесть на телегу до Райзенберга, но села не на ту.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:5.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:5.original: Before I knew it, I was here in Merveille.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:5.translation: Не успела оглянуться — уже здесь, в Мервейле.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:6.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:6.original: Hahaha! That's just like you, Pamela!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:6.translation: Ха-ха-ха! Это так на тебя похоже, Памела!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:7.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:7.original: What do you think? Should I make something to whisk you back to Kirchen Bell?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:7.translation: Как думаешь? Может, сделать что-нибудь, чтобы быстро вернуть тебя в Кирхенбелл?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:8.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:8.original: That seems like the best way to get you back to your church, Pamela... The only way?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:8.translation: Кажется, это лучший способ вернуть тебя в твою церковь, Памела... Единственный способ?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:9.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:9.original: I don't need anything of the sort! Don't treat me like some clumsy child, please.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:9.translation: Мне ничего такого не нужно! Не обращайся со мной как с неуклюжим ребёнком, пожалуйста.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:11.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:11.original: Still, it's nice to have you here, Pamela. It's so reassuring, having you close.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:11.translation: И всё же приятно, что ты здесь, Памела. Так спокойнее, когда ты рядом.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:12.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:12.original: Me too, Sophie. Being near you really soothes my spirit.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:12.translation: Мне тоже, Софи. Рядом с тобой мой дух и правда успокаивается.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:13.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:13.original: I'm glad to hear it. I'd better be going, for today, anyway.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:13.translation: Приятно слышать. На сегодня мне лучше идти.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:14.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:14.original: I'll come again soon! See you later!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:15.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:15.original: Hold on. I've just realized something.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:15.translation: Погоди. Я только что кое-что поняла.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:16.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:16.original: If Sophie is so big now, all the kids at the church must have grown up too!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:16.translation: Если Софи теперь такая большая, значит, все дети в церкви тоже выросли!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:17.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:17.original: Oh, my! I hope they haven't forgotten about me! I'm quite worried!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_070.ebm:17.translation: О боже! Надеюсь, они обо мне не забыли! Я очень волнуюсь!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:0.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:0.original: Mr. Fritz, Drossel! Your last puppet show was the best!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:0.translation: Мистер Фриц, Дроссель! Ваш последний кукольный спектакль был лучшим!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:1.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:1.original: A Mysterious, Mysterious Story! It was so great!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:1.translation: «Таинственная, таинственная история»! Это было так здорово!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:2.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:2.original: You based it on us, too! It made me really happy.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:2.translation: Вы ещё и нас взяли за основу! Мне было очень приятно.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:3.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:3.original: We should be thanking you. You two live such a rich and interesting lives!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:3.translation: Это мы должны вас благодарить. Вы двое живёте такой насыщенной и интересной жизнью!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:4.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:4.original: The perfect material for the ultimate puppet theater!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:4.translation: Идеальный материал для лучшего кукольного театра!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:5.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:5.original: You said it, Drossel. The mini Plachta and new full-size Firis really worked well, too.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:5.translation: Точно сказано, Дроссель. Мини-Плахта и новый полноразмерный Фирис тоже отлично сработали.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:6.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:6.original: Haha! That Firis puppet suddenly coming out like that really surprised me!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:6.translation: Ха-ха! Эта кукла Фирис, внезапно появившаяся вот так, меня очень удивила!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:7.original: Hey, that reminds me! I didn't sign off on you using my likeness!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:7.translation: Эй, кстати! Я не давала разрешения использовать моё подобие!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:8.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:8.original: Really? You didn't? Well, it's all for the sake of great entertainment. I hope that's alright.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:8.translation: Правда? Не давала? Ну, всё ради отличного развлечения. Надеюсь, это нормально.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:9.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:9.original: I guess she is one of the stars... I suppose I don't mind.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:9.translation: Наверное, она одна из звёзд... Думаю, я не против.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:10.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:10.original: Hey, Firis and Sophie. Here to see Mr. Fritz and Drossel?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:10.translation: Эй, Фирис и Софи. Пришли к мистеру Фрицу и Дроссель?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:11.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:11.original: Yes, to tell them how much we loved their show at the church. I've been their biggest fan for years!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:11.translation: Да, сказать им, как сильно нам понравилось их представление в церкви. Я уже много лет их самая большая поклонница!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:12.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:12.original: Me too! It was so moving, we just had to thank them!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:12.translation: Я тоже! Было так трогательно — просто обязаны были поблагодарить!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:13.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:13.original: Hey, so you were in the audience? Hold on! That means...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:13.translation: Эй, так вы были в зале? Погоди! Значит...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:14.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:14.original: Yes, we saw your comedy routine too! "Once upon a time... Hey, Once. What are you doing? Get off of Time!"
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:14.translation: Да, мы и ваш комедийный номер видели! «Однажды... Эй, Однажды. Что ты делаешь? Слезай с Времени!»

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:15.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:15.original: Ah! Ah! You can just forget all that!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:15.translation: Ах! Ах! Можете всё это просто забыть!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:16.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:16.original: Hahaha! Fritz, Drossel. The story about the two of them was really good, too, wasn't it?
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:16.translation: Ха-ха-ха! Фриц, Дроссель. История о них двоих тоже была очень хороша, правда?

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:17.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:17.original: Yes. Whatever lies in their future, I'm sure they'll be very happy.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:17.translation: Да. Что бы ни ждало их в будущем, уверена — они будут очень счастливы.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:18.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:18.original: That's why I ended it with a full-blown happy ending! Hehe, I'm very proud of that script.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:18.translation: Поэтому я закончила её полноценным счастливым концом! Хе-хе, очень горжусь этим сценарием.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:19.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:19.original: You should be! I'm proud to have you as my daughter, Drossel!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:19.translation: И правильно! Я горжусь, что ты моя дочь, Дроссель!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:20.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:20.original: Thanks, Dad! Now, seeing as you're all here...
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:20.translation: Спасибо, папа! А раз уж вы все здесь...

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:21.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:21.original: I know exactly what you're thinking. Time to put on an encore performance!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:21.translation: Точно знаю, о чём ты думаешь. Пора устроить выступление на бис!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:22.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:22.original: Great! With the Malen sisters as the opening act!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:23.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:23.original: Hold it, Firis. Don't make fun of us!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:23.translation: Погоди, Фирис. Не издевайся над нами!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:24.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:24.original: I want to see the puppet show, but I've had enough of the stage for now!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:24.translation: Я хочу посмотреть кукольный спектакль, но со сцены мне пока хватит!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:25.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:25.original: Hahaha, no worries. It sounds like we're up, Drossel!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:25.translation: Ха-ха-ха, не волнуйся. Похоже, наш выход, Дроссель!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:26.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:26.original: You can count on me, Dad! Let's move these folks right out of their seats!
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_080.ebm:26.translation: Можешь на меня рассчитывать, папа! Давайте сорвём этих зрителей с мест!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:0.original: We shouldn't be going that way right now.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:0.translation: Сейчас нам не стоит идти туда.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:3.original: We shouldn't leave the city at the moment.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:3.translation: Сейчас нам не стоит покидать город.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:4.original: We shouldn't be synthesizing right now.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:4.translation: Сейчас нам не стоит заниматься синтезом.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:5.original: We can't go to bed at the moment.
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:5.translation: Сейчас мы не можем лечь спать.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:6.original: We can't go that way now!

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:7.original: We can't get through this way.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:9.original: We can't go outside right now.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:10.original: Let's not synthesize at the moment.

ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms05/event_message_ms05_090.ebm:11.original: There's no time to be sleeping!
